description: This file implements URL parsing and encoding functionalities, defines URL schemes, and part of URL handling class within the WPEFramework namespace. It includes functions for URL encoding, decoding, base64 encoding and decoding, and parsing URL components like scheme, hostname, path, query, and fragment.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing and formatting URLs, including extracting components like scheme, host, path, query, and fragment.

methods.name: URL::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a source string into a URL-safe format, converting special characters to '%' notation.

methods.name: URL::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string back to its original form.

methods.name: URL::Base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string with optional padding.

methods.name: URL::Base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into binary data, considering ignore list characters.

methods.name: URL::Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components: scheme, username, password, host, port, path, query, and fragment.

methods.name: URL::ParseDomain
methods.description: Parses the domain part of a URL, extracting host and port.

methods.name: URL::Text
methods.description: Returns a reconstructed string representation of the URL.

uint32_t FindNext(const TextFragment & url,const uint32_t start,const uint32_t end)
